# CampusEduX

> Tutorials, coding practice, interview preparation and student tools.

CampusEduX provides public learning resources alongside account-based tools and services. Follow each page's access rules; this file does not grant access to private records or premium content. Current facts, availability and prices are defined by the linked pages.

## Learning
- [Tutorials](https://www.campusedux.com/learning): Browse published courses and their lessons.
- [Java tutorial](https://www.campusedux.com/learning/java-tutorial): Java lessons and examples.
- [Python tutorial](https://www.campusedux.com/learning/python-tutorial): Python lessons and exercises.
- [DBMS and SQL](https://www.campusedux.com/learning/dbms-sql-tutorial): Database concepts and SQL lessons.
- [Coding practice](https://www.campusedux.com/practice/problems): Published programming exercises.
- [Interview questions](https://www.campusedux.com/practice/interview-questions): Topic-based questions and answers.
- [Blog](https://www.campusedux.com/blog): Published articles.

## Tools and services
- [Online compiler](https://www.campusedux.com/compiler): Run supported programming languages.
- [Resume builder](https://www.campusedux.com/resume): Create and edit a resume.
- [Resume templates](https://www.campusedux.com/resume/templates): Explore available template designs.
- [Project mentoring and custom software](https://www.campusedux.com/custom-projects): See current service scope.

## Publisher information
- [About](https://www.campusedux.com/about): About the platform.
- [Contact](https://www.campusedux.com/contact): Contact and support options.
- [Legal policies](https://www.campusedux.com/legal): Terms, privacy and related policies.
- [Sitemap index](https://www.campusedux.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs currently included in sitemaps.
